specs: Drivers Ø52 mm, three axles per side at x 65 / -15 / -95 (wheelbase 160 mm), wheel centres z 26 on rail top z 0; track rails 700 x 8 x 10 at y ±33 on 9 sleepers
Boiler barrel Ø54 x 190 (x -85..105) at z 78; smokebox Ø55 x 30 (x 90..120) with Ø40 door and dart; chimney with flared cap to z 128, moved forward to x 108 so its cap clears the tank's front face
Saddle tank Ø66 x 115 at z 103; underside cut with an r 28 cylinder about the boiler axis, clearing the barrel by 1.0 mm and the smokebox by 0.5 mm; filler cap on top
Cab x -145..-85 with spectacle discs on the front sheet, roof (76 x 92 x 5) top at z 152.5; rear bunker with 5 coal lumps

Crank pins r4 at radius 14, all in phase (pin ahead of axle at axle height, pins at x -81 / -1 / 79); coupling rods 174 x 5 x 10 centred on the pin span in the y ±43 plane, eyes bored r 4.4 on the pins; piston cylinders Ø22 x 44 at x 96..140 in the same plane
Overall 335 mm over running board and buffers; mass 12.57 kg as modelled (volume 1,606,271 mm^3, solid parts, steel 7850 / cast-iron 7200 kg/m^3 per part)
